description:
PerfectPost is a tool to write, schedule and analyze LinkedIn content. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your PerfectPost account, with read and write access to your posts, drafts and LinkedIn profile.

What you can do:

- Analyze your posts: impressions, likes, comments, shares and reposts over any date range, with an aggregated summary and your top posts.
- Find past content: list, search and re-read your published posts, then reuse them in a new draft.
- Understand your audience: see who liked or commented on a post.
- Write and schedule: create a draft, edit it, attach an image, video or PDF, then schedule it for publication on LinkedIn at the date and time you choose.
- Check your LinkedIn profile: name, headline and follower count.

The plugin only accesses data from the connected PerfectPost account. Nothing is published on LinkedIn without an explicit scheduling request. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE through the PerfectPost identity provider. A free PerfectPost account is enough; some analytics over a longer history require a paid plan.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my LinkedIn post performance over the last 30 days and show me the best one.
Who liked and commented on my most viewed post this year?
Write a LinkedIn post about [topic] and schedule it for next Tuesday at 8:30 am.
